known.title: Gate: Python copy-in smoke test conflicts with the starter's table inventory
Gate: checkpoint blob deletion is not exercised

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - CI runs the Python storage proof with FORGE_STARTER_LIVE=1.
This invokes the copied app's complete test suite. However, src/forge/templates/starter-python/apps/api/tests/test_module_schemas.py:53–62 compares the complete database table inventory against a fixed list containing no assistant tables. The copied migration and lifespan add assistant.chat and four checkpoint tables, so that existing assertion necessarily fails. Neither the helper nor README updates this inventory. Although full API proof belongs to PYCHAT, this branch's own storage proof selects that failing test. Update the documented copy steps and helper to preserve the inventory check with the additional tables.
findings.title: Gate: Python copy-in smoke test conflicts with the starter's table inventory

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test.
Case: normal use - proving that expired conversations lose all checkpoint copies.
The fixture supplies only a string channel value. The pinned [PostgresSaver 3.2.0 implementation](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/blob/checkpointpostgres%3D%3D3.2.0/libs/checkpoint-postgres/langgraph/checkpoint/postgres/__init__.py#L293-L315) stores primitive values inline, so this creates no checkpoint_blobs rows. Consequently, the aggregate zero-row assertion passes even if deletion leaves every blob behind, making the proof list's blob-erasure claim hollow. Store a nonprimitive channel value, such as a message list, and establish that its blob exists before cleanup before asserting its removal.
